name: The gate stamp
words: Stamped at the old gate. Tap to hear it land.

normal.name: The gate stamp
normal.words: Stamped at the old gate. Tap to hear it land.

longest.name: The stamp of the weavers' guild by the gate
longest.words: Every cart that came through the old gate was stamped here, and the toll was written beside the stamp in the gate book, which the guild kept until the fire.
